purpose: Test the frozen requirement that every 2019-2025 local trading session has a published full-market securities-lending partition, without reading prices or returns.

source.provider: Eastmoney public consolidated exchange margin-trading detail

method.initial_full_sync: The frozen streamed sync count-verified 243 sessions before the first missing local session and then stopped. Its source request retried the missing partition five times.
method.coverage_scan: Request page 1 for every frozen local session with the same five-field whitelist and four fixed workers; a session passes presence only when success is true and both page count and advertised row count are positive.
method.neighbor_and_range_confirmation: Query adjacent sessions and bounded date ranges with the same whitelist. Neighboring sessions returned positive counts, while the four dates remained absent from range counts.

decision.reason: The frozen public-source continuity requirement failed on four local trading sessions.
prohibited_rescues: substitute financing, price, market-cap, or return fields
mix another provider into the frozen single-source contract
run a capacity or return diagnostic on the incomplete snapshot
use the factor in aggregation, current scoring, or stock selection
